objective: Kill Lord Aliden Perenolde and ask his mistress, Elysa, about Taretha's pendant.

description: It is clear that Perenolde must be killed, his foulness removed from the world. His manor lies a ways to the north of here, on the shores of Lordamere Lake. Do your duty, <name>, then retrieve the pendant that the Warchief desires, and return here.
completion: No, no please don't hurt me! I never meant your people any harm, he's had me against my will! Please... spare me!
